units.source_text: 从照片上或教科书里，我经常看到现实的金阁，然而在我心中，父亲所讲的金阁的幻影，远胜于现实的金阁。

en.t: In photographs or textbooks, I often saw the real Golden Pavilion, yet in my heart, the phantom Golden Pavilion my father spoke of far surpassed the real one.

units.source_text: 父亲决不会说现实的金阁是金光闪闪之类的话。

en.t: My father would never say that the real Golden Pavilion glittered with gold or anything of that sort.

units.source_text: 按父亲讲述，人世间再没有比金阁更美的东西了。

en.t: According to my father, there was nothing in this world more beautiful than the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 同时，我内心里从金阁这个字面及其音韵所描绘出的金阁，是无与伦比的。

en.t: At the same time, the Golden Pavilion that took shape within me from the written words and their sound was beyond compare.
